Corollary
[Existence of maximal geodesics]

↗ thm:geodesic-existence-uniqueness 1. ch4:4.28

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and $ abla $ a connection in $TM$. For every $p\in M$ and $v\in T_pM$, there is a unique maximal geodesic $\gamma \colon I o M$ on an open interval $I i 0$ satisfying $\gamma (0)=p$ and $\gamma '(0)=v$.

Proof

\sketch Take the union of all open intervals containing $0$ on which a geodesic with the prescribed data exists. Theorem 15 makes the local geodesics agree on overlaps, so they glue to the unique maximal one.

□

Write $\gamma _v$ for the maximal geodesic with initial velocity $v$ and initial point $\pi (v)$, where $\pi \colon TM o M$ is the bundle projection.
